author: reek
body: Regression: a pure leaf whose body is `let x = e in if ... then ... else x` took the minimal-leaf fast path, whose leaf-profile under-counted the anonymous locals emit-let allocates for the if in value position (compare spill + result). The self-check then halted with CDX2000 "minimal leaf mispredict". Fixed by falling back to the standard emitter on a mispredict instead of erroring.
